query:
SELECT 
  ws.name AS schedule_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_registrants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.phone IS NOT NULL AND wr.phone != '' AND wr.optedOut = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_textable,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.optedOut = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opted_out,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.phone IS NULL OR wr.phone = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_phone,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.attendanceStatus = 'attended' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attended,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.attendanceStatus = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_shows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wr.attendanceStatus = 'registered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS registered_only
FROM webinar_registrants wr
JOIN webinar_schedules ws ON wr.scheduleId = ws.id
GROUP BY ws.id, ws.name
ORDER BY ws.id DESC
